changes.title: Dolphins kraken
items: Dolphins leap out of the sea off the east coast at night, alone or in pairs
Off the west coast, very rarely, something huge stirs in the moonlit water

changes.title: Fireworks sound
items: Fireworks over a cleared area now whoosh, boom and crackle, and the party under them cheers

changes.title: Ley after boot
items: The ley line to the first runestone no longer shows before the boot: it branches off the home ring as the boot's pulse goes past where it leaves it (about a third of the way round), its tip running out to the first stone as the boot finishes the ring.
